gen-almendra-display-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab is a text serif with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and a tall x-height that holds up on a screen. Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary flourish, and the body keeps things grounded.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-henta: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads refined and traditional, with subtle stroke modulation. Almendra Display makes the ornate, literary entrance, then the body's open-jawed curves and near-capital small letters take over.
gen-almendra-display-gf-ovo: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary tone with a pronounced x-height, while Ovo adds lightly shaded texture to every word. The standout is how softly Ovo's thins trail its thicks.
gen-archivo-black-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Fauna One carries the quiet, bookish dignity underneath, while Archivo Black punches in with urban authority.
gen-archivo-black-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and wide, unclosed curves giving a tall lowercase plenty of breathing space. Archivo Black delivers the punch; Glegoo does the quiet work in paragraphs.
gen-archivo-black-gf-hanuman: Archivo Black is all urban authority, its x-height packing the middle of the line. Hanuman, a text serif whose high-waisted lowercase has wide-set terminals on s, handles the refined reading.
gen-archivo-black-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a serif with open-ended curves and an oversized x-height, giving it a distinctly classic editorial look. Archivo Black brings the urban shout; Kadwa keeps the conversation going.
gen-archivo-black-gf-noticia-text: Loud, urban and sure of itself, Archivo Black fills the middle of every line. And Noticia Text, with big entrances into each curve and lowercase bodies filling most of the height, keeps a full page dignified.
gen-archivo-black-gf-piazzolla: Authoritative and urban, Archivo Black leaves lots of room around each letter shape. Piazzolla brings refined restraint, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened like a pried clasp.
gen-archivo-black-gf-pridi: Pridi gives curve ends generous space from the stem, and its small letters stand proud, almost capital-sized. Pridi feels refined and classic beside Archivo Black's urban authority, a steadying counterweight.
